summary: A compiled command-line tool with subcommands, JSON results, lazy configuration and structured logs.
description: Create a TypeScript command-line utility compiled with Bun. Effect owns commands, services, configuration and errors; results stay on stdout while diagnostics use stderr. Help, version and doctor work independently of optional application configuration. Tests exercise the command tree and compiled binary. Add your own commands after the base passes, then select bun-release for distribution or openrouter-chat-cli for the terminal chat application.
seoDescription: A Bun-compiled TypeScript CLI with Effect commands, JSON output, lazy configuration and tests of both source commands and the executable.

projectExamples.title: Project diagnostics utility
projectExamples.description: Add checks for project files and environment settings, reporting actionable findings to people and JSON to automation. The base already establishes doctor and output behavior.

projectExamples.title: Terminal model notebook
projectExamples.description: Select openrouter-chat-cli for saved chat, scriptable model commands and a terminal interface. Add bun-release separately if you also want installation and update workflows.

plain.whatItIs: A starter terminal program written in TypeScript, a typed form of JavaScript, packaged as one file you can run.
goodAt: Commands with predictable output for people and for scripts
Testing the packaged program as well as its source code
Keeping help and diagnostic commands working even when settings are broken
notGoodAt: Full-screen terminal programs with menus and panels; add a dedicated interface tool.
Installers or self-updating programs; add those separately.

requests: build a terminal utility I can distribute as an executable
let scripts consume results while diagnostics go to stderr
keep help and diagnostics working when configuration is broken
goodFor: stable exit codes and safe errors
testing commands before and after compilation
